fusions.name: Shake Loose the Moss
fusions.desc: Shakes the spore-moss off your shell, which deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and you heal for 10 health.

fusions.name: Ripe for Picking
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A blow that deals 16 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 2 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Spore-Crusted Back
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Larger Each Morning
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.6 health a second.
